environment: Claude Code cloud container used only as a development tool; Linux, Node.js 22, local headless Chromium 1194

checks.skip_reason: Opt-in browser review, export and player tests; run separately with MOTION_REVIEW_BROWSER

checks.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_codex_install.py
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_package_identity.py
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_gepa_studio_pilot.py (optional GEPA dependency installed)

boundary: Source checks and local runs; style suitability is a design judgement, and whether ChatGPT or ChatGPT Work offers styles, runs the scripts or follows the review passes is not verified. All 201 planned cases remain not_run.

runs.styles: six token styles applied to the two-statements example: check-score PASS, Python renders, text contrast 12.3:1 to 19.3:1 (foreground) and 5.5:1 to 7.9:1 (muted)
runs.beats: beats.py on a synthetic 32 s click track: 120.002 BPM, bar 1 at 0.250 s, clear downbeat, drop at bar 9; music_edit.py cut 4 bars to 240 frames (8.000 s at 30 FPS)
runs.motion_blur: --blur 8 leaves hold frames byte-identical and blurs the sweep; --stills-width 360 scales stills
runs.retained_scripts: beats.py and music_edit.py byte-identical to the recorded upstream hashes
